title: Awesome AI Language
author: Dangerous_Three_8506
selftext:
Does anyone know of any other great AI words?

I know of Live Coding, Generation Presets, Axioms and built in Codex/Claude. These words are defining my relation with AI, anyone know of any other great words?  


(Sorry if these words are mis defined, I am learning as I go, its the workflow/concept that matters)

Live Coding is where a light weight AI can have simple instructions to uncomment or comment code that is running as you work on an editor/game/studio. This is a great asset/tool to get working on your projects. The thought of live coding clears my mind and lets me work deeper with AI. I can request AI to disable features and enable features differently then I ever thought of before.

Generation presets is similar, its where the AI disables/enables an entire Folder. You have 3 folders named Maple, Oak and Palm. These three folders operate Seed numbers and share the exact same \*.cpp File name. You disable Maple and Palm then the Oak seeds are applied to the game. You can disable Oak and Maple, then the Palm seeds are applied to the game. Everyone knows how seeds work right? But did you know about Seed types?

Axioms is where you can give the AI an axiom and it isn't allowed to break the law of the Axiom. This is useful if you are attempting to bring imagination, gaming and religion together. The AI likes to tell you what God is and isn't with no debate. You can define god with Axioms. You can also change how words are spelt with Axioms, you can tell an ai that Star is spelt Ztar with an axiom.

Built in Codex/Claude is great for everything. You can talk to the ai directly in your studio/game debugger. I don't need to talk about how awesome this is when you get it working with backups and safety nets.

  
Thanks for listening, please share your awesome ai language so I can learn more.
